name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA’s core engine to the latest Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It delivers the highest reasoning quality among available models, proven in recent benchmarks to outperform peers in complex task execution—critical for EXCAVA’s power-focused workloads. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but the 0.5%+ capability gain justifies it by reducing errors and retries.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t cost—it’s that 3.7 Sonnet’s 0.5% reasoning gain is unproven for EXCAVA’s specific workloads. A better alternative is testing the older, cheaper 3.5 Sonnet first; if it meets the 0.5% threshold, the upgrade is unnecessary. Settle it with a controlled A/B run: measure EXCAVA’s output quality with both models, blind-reviewed by the team, before committing.
